title: Development Engineer
abstract: Help shape a growing community as a Development Engineer. Enjoy flexible work, a vehicle allowance and outstanding benefits.
bullets: One of the Fastest Growing Local Governments in Australia
Family Friendly - 9-day Fortnights / Hybrid WFH / Paid Parental Leave!
12% Super - Choose to co-contribute and receive up to 18%!
content_text:
DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER
- Full Time, Permanent - with flexible work options
- One of the Fastest Growing Local Governments in Australia! Great Career Opportunities!
- Family Friendly - 9-day Fortnights / Hybrid WFH / Paid Parental Leave!
- 12% Super - Choose to co-contribute and receive up to 18%!
Avoid the city chaos and embrace the family friendly, country town atmosphere of Mundijong! Use your proven background in Subdivisions to help shape our rapidly growing Shire.
Why you want the role
Located just 45 kilometres from the Perth CBD on the picturesque backdrop of the Darling Scarp, The Shire of Serpentine Jarrahdale is one of the fastest growing Local Governments in Australia. What that means is that we are transforming the way our community works, lives and plays. It's an exciting time at "The Shire" and if you want to be part of that energy and excitement then we have the opportunity for you.
What's in it for you?
The Shire has a fantastic opportunity to join its Engineering team on a full-time basis. If successful, you would have the potential to start immediately.
 The Development Engineer role is responsible for contributing to the strategic objectives and daily operations of the Subdivisions Team. You will primarily review and manage subdivision and development applications in collaboration with and provide timely professional engineering advice to internal and external stakeholders.
 Other major responsibilities will include undertaking regular site supervision of works to ensure compliance with relevant policies, guidelines and specifications as well as maintaining a working knowledge of design, construction, operation and maintenance principles for Local Government infrastructure, facilities and services.
 If this sounds like you, and you believe your experience and capabilities satisfy the criteria listed in the attached Position Description, we want to hear from you!
The Important Stuff!
A competitive negotiated remuneration package, including a vehicle allowance and Shire-provided mobile phone, is offered for this position.
 Not only will you have the opportunity to swap the city chaos for our fabulous natural environment and quiet rural outlook, here are some other great benefits:
- Free local gym membership.
- If you choose to contribute additional super, we will match up to 3% as a co-contribution.
- Wellness programs including Fitness passport.
- Free counselling, health assessments and health insurance discounts, annual flu vaccination and skin cancer screening.
- 22kW AC Charger for electric vehicles.
- Two additional Local Government days off per year.
- The option of Purchased Leave.
- Salary packaging options, including novated leasing.
- Professional development opportunities - study leave and study assistance.
- Free Onsite Parking.
About the Shire! 
 With the Administration office located in Mundijong just 45 minutes from the Perth CBD on the picturesque backdrop of the Darling Scarp, our Shire is one of the fastest growing Local Governments in Australia. 
 Our community come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do but because it makes our organisation stronger. 
 Where do I apply? 
 Submit your resume online today! We are reviewing applications as they come in and the position may close earlier than expected. We recommend you apply as soon as possible. We encourage applications from all areas, including Mandurah, Peel and Pinjarra regions.
 Note: The Shire will collect personal information from you during the recruitment process, which will only be used or disclosed when required to effectively process your application.
